Placemaker.Polish.Name: Look
Placemaker.Polish.sideReach.Tooltip: How far a garden reaches sideways to meet the neighbour beside it. Very large values make the polish slower in big cities.
Placemaker.Polish.maxFrontGap.Tooltip: Two neighbours this far apart at the street still join (one shared fence or hedge).
Placemaker.Polish.maxBackGap.Tooltip: How far apart their back corners may be (wedges on the outside of a curve).
Placemaker.Polish.maxRearGap.Tooltip: Two gardens back to back this far apart meet in the middle.
Placemaker.Polish.maxFacingGap.Tooltip: A side facing another house's side or back this far away meets it halfway.
Placemaker.Polish.maxDeepen.Tooltip: A shallow garden reaches back to its row's deepest by up to this much.
Placemaker.Polish.hug.Tooltip: A side or back nobody else has grows out to a road, path or building near it and hugs it.
Placemaker.Polish.hugReach.Tooltip: How far a garden reaches out to a road, path or building.
Placemaker.Polish.openReach.Tooltip: A side or back with nothing near it still grows this far into open land. Very large values fill whole fields.
Placemaker.Polish.wrap.Tooltip: Two deep gardens meet behind a shallow one between them.
Placemaker.Polish.closeBacks.Tooltip: A garden open at the back closes with a fence or hedge the joining freed.
Placemaker.Polish.closeGardens.Tooltip: Every open edge of a garden (not its street front) gets fence or hedge pieces, following its bends and the roads it hugs.
Placemaker.Polish.fenceKind.Tooltip: What closes the open edges: the house's own fence or hedge kind, or one for every house.
Placemaker.Polish.lawns.Tooltip: A garden's lawn grows to its new fences, around driveways and paving.
Placemaker.Polish.lawnReach.Tooltip: Mowed lawn this far from the house; a big garden is painted further out. 400 or more: lawn everywhere.
Placemaker.Polish.paintedGardens.Tooltip: How many gardens are painted instead of keeping their lawns. Natural and Yard more often, Tidy seldom.
Placemaker.Polish.gardenPaint.Tooltip: How strong the paint of a painted garden is.
Placemaker.Polish.paint.Tooltip: Soft ground past the gardens and worn ground along fences facing open land.
Placemaker.Polish.blendWidth.Tooltip: How far the paint reaches past the gardens.
Placemaker.Polish.blendFar.Tooltip: How far the fainter, wider band reaches.
Placemaker.Polish.blendStrength.Tooltip: How strong the paint past the gardens is.
Placemaker.Polish.gardenLayer.Tooltip: The ground a painted garden is painted with.
Placemaker.Polish.meadowLayer.Tooltip: The ground of a big garden beyond its lawn near the house.
Placemaker.Polish.blendLayer.Tooltip: The ground of the band just past the gardens.
Placemaker.Polish.blendFarLayer.Tooltip: The ground of the wider, fainter band further out.
Placemaker.Polish.edgeLayer.Tooltip: Worn ground along back fences that face open land.
Placemaker.Polish.edgeWidth.Tooltip: How wide the worn band along those fences is.
Placemaker.Polish.roadLayer.Tooltip: A band along the roads and paths beside the gardens.
Placemaker.Polish.roadWidth.Tooltip: How wide the band along roads and paths is.
Placemaker.Polish.rockLayer.Tooltip: The ground under rock gardens and outcrops.
Placemaker.Polish.rockGround.Tooltip: The wider ground around an outcrop.
Placemaker.Polish.yardLayer.Tooltip: The ground of a storage yard.
Placemaker.Polish.patchLayer.Tooltip: The ground of the worn patches in big gardens.
Placemaker.Polish.patchChance.Tooltip: How many worn patches big gardens get.
Placemaker.Polish.plant.Tooltip: Planted beds with bushes along new fences. Off: no planting, features, paths or rocks.
Placemaker.Polish.bedChance.Tooltip: How often a new fence gets a bed with bushes.
Placemaker.Polish.bushesPerGarden.Toolti: The most bushes the beds of one garden get.
Placemaker.Polish.features.Tooltip: Big new garden land gets something by its look: a rock garden, a sand pit, a log pile, a bench nook, a flower garden, a storage yard.
Placemaker.Polish.featureChance.Tooltip: How many big gardens get a feature.
Placemaker.Polish.featureSpacing.Tooltip: A big garden gets one more feature for every this much new land (at most 6).
Placemaker.Polish.featureMinLand.Tooltip: New garden land a feature needs.
Placemaker.Polish.rockChance.Tooltip: How often a rock sits where two gardens meet at the street (never against a hedge).
Placemaker.Polish.pathChance.Tooltip: How many big gardens get a paved path from the house to the back.
Placemaker.Polish.alleys.Tooltip: A narrow even gap between two houses becomes a paved walkway.
Placemaker.Polish.alleyChance.Tooltip: How often a narrow gap becomes a walkway.
Placemaker.Polish.pavedFill.Tooltip: Shops, offices and works fill the land between them with the surface most of their ground already is, not lawn.
